rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
depicted_variant: Paul Bunyan raksasa versi kisah tinggi mustahil Laughead, menarik kapak yang mengeruk ngarai.

visual_requirements.description: Lelaki penebang raksasa menjulang jauh di atas pohon, satu kepala dua lengan dua kaki; kapak besar.
Kapak yang ditarik membelah tanah menjadi ngarai, batu/debu jatuh di bekas bilah.
Bentang ngarai yang sedang diciptakan di Amerika.

aura: Keagungan fisik raksasa lebih tinggi daripada pohon c06 dan kapak yang menciptakan Grand Canyon c08.
artistic_choices: Ukuran mustahil dipilih eksplisit dari varian Laughead c06, bukan versi awal setinggi manusia.
Pakaian kerja buram, janggut, palet walnut, cahaya senja dan pembingkaian rendah editorial; tidak meniru ilustrasi merek Laughead.
Babe tidak digambar demi pusat subjek Paul; c01 menyebut biasanya ditemani, bukan kewajiban setiap adegan.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Paul Bunyan, the giant North American folk lumberjack, in the impossible-size tall-tale variant [paul-bunyan-c01, paul-bunyan-c06].
ANATOMY: one colossal human man with one head, two arms and two legs, rugged bearded face, opaque weathered brown wool work shirt, heavy trousers and boots; both hands grip the long wooden haft of one enormous iron logging axe [paul-bunyan-c08]. Original appearance, no branded or cartoon costume.
MOMENT: STRIDING toward and above the viewer, looking downward with fierce focused exertion as he drags the axe behind one leg; his broad shoulders and face occupy the upper two thirds, boots loom near the camera.
POWER: the dragged axe blade physically gouges a deep canyon through layered rock behind him, huge rock shelves shearing along the blade's narrow track and dust tumbling into the new gorge [paul-bunyan-c08].
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low-angle from below his boot; distant pine trees barely reach his ankle, showing he towers above trees [paul-bunyan-c06]. The giant is the dominant subject, not a landscape.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one low copper sunset side light on face, axe and rock dust, deep warm walnut shadows.
SURFACE: coarse wool, weathered leather, battered iron axe, fractured sandstone strata.
SETTING: the rocky American canyon his dragged axe is creating [paul-bunyan-c08].
MOOD: benevolent folk hero rendered overwhelming and awe-inspiring through strength, never evil, calm, comic or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, logo, border or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no ox required; no design borrowed from film, game, anime, comic or branded Paul Bunyan imagery; fully opaque clothes, no gore; no glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons.
